question: How did the Shakti army's stream surround the demon army's heart?
premises: shakti army stream surrounded demon army heart
the heart is the object of surrounding
inference: The Shakti army's stream flowed all around the heart of the demon army.
uncertainties: hṛdaṃ may represent hṛdaya in accusative
plain_english: The stream of the Shakti army surrounded the heart of the demon army on every side.
